line: Crowley’s Two of Cups: Love, Venus in Cancer, placed with the Twos at Chokmah.

sections.title: What Crowley names
sections.line: The chapter name for the card. The second quotation gives the element of its suit.

quotes.quote: The Two of Cups is the Lord of Love
“Wands”, attributed to Fire; “Cups”, to Water; “Swords”, to Air;

sections.title: Its place on the Tree
sections.line: The Twos essay says these cards refer to Chokmah. The Two of Cups chapter does not repeat the sephira, and names Venus in Cancer.

quotes.quote: The card also refers to Venus in Cancer.

sections.title: What it figures
sections.line: Crowley says the Two is the Word and the Will, and reads the card as the harmony of the male and the female.

quotes.quote: The Two always represents the Word and the Will. It is the first manifestation.
It shows the harmony of the male and the female: interpreted in the largest sense.
